pyramiding_rule: No pyramiding into unconfirmed breakouts; scale-ins strictly prohibited unless existing position has locked in at least +$3.00 trailing profit.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require a minimum 1.5 ATR buffer for initial stop-loss placement on XAUUSD to prevent noise wicks from prematurely closing trades.
profit_harvest_threshold: Aggressively trail stop-loss to breakeven once floating profit hits +$2.50, and execute partial harvest scaling at +$15.00 while letting the remainder run to +$30.00.
